16.critic_justification: initialize() calls ensureAnonymous() (auth_controller.dart:162), which creates a Firebase user via signInAnonymously() at line 191 and starts DdayCloudSync. Google sign-in links or signs in with a credential (lines 266-286) and calls UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser() at line 292. The Settings Account section (settings_screen.dart:138-168) only offers nickname editing and Login/Logout. signOut() (lines 302-318) and _clearUser() (lines 418-425) sign out of Firebase and Google and remove local auth prefs; they do not delete the remote user. AccountDeletionScreen (account_deletion_screen.dart:17-47) only launches mailto:idoyun781@gmail.com or https://doyun0327.github.io/quotation/delete-account.html. A search of lib/**/*.dart finds no other reference to AccountDeletionScreen and no Firebase user.delete() or other remote account-purge call, so the deletion UI is unreachable.
